Class Point

java.lang.Object
Point
All Implemented Interfaces:
Geometry
class Point extends Object implements Geometry
Point class. Virtually every class here uses this in some way. 2 dimensional.

John McKeighen

      public Point(String name, float x, float y)
      Class constructor.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the point. Conventionally a single character like "A" or "P".
      x - The x coordinate of the point.
      y - The y coordinate of the point.

      public static float distance(Point p1, Point p2)
      Distance between two points.

      Returns:
      The distance between p1 and p2, calculated using the Pythagorean Theorem.

    • angle

      public static float angle(Point A, Point B, Point C)
      Measure of an angle between three points. Mathematically would be written as m∠ABC, here written like Point.angle(A, B, C);.
      Parameters:
      A - The first point.
      B - The second point. The angle is measured from here.
      C - The third point.
      Returns:
      The measure of the angle between A, B, and C.
